Constance: "In the interest of the town and proper order, I shall be plain: I am the Clerk."

Merrin: "Oh, a chill runs down my spine whenever Greta passes—mark them well, neighbors!"  [case board: #19, #20, #21]

Odette: "Word reached me from the Surveyor, who sensibly prefers to stay unnamed: they learned that not everyone living on the Square shares the same alignment."
Odette: "Miraculously, Greta and I are of one mind regarding Agnes."  [case board: #25, #26]
